# CANDIDATE: VWAP_REVERSION_BULLISH_ENGULFING

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to revert to the intraday VWAP after a significant deviation when the EMA ribbon is bullishly aligned and a bullish engulfing candle closes above VWAP. This setup captures mean-reversion momentum in low‑to‑moderate VIX environments during midday hours, exploiting the statistical tendency of SPY to snap back to VWAP after extended deviations.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When SPY deviates more than 1.5×ATR below the session VWAP, the EMA ribbon (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55) is bullish, and a bullish engulfing candle closes above VWAP, enter long at the close of that candle.  
**Exit:** Initial stop is the most recent swing low (structure invalidation). Take profit 1 at 1.5×risk. The remaining runner is trailed with a chandelier exit (ATR×3). Additional regime filters: VIX < 20 and time between 10:30‑14:00 EST.
